channel.title: The Local France - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from The Local France (thelocal.fr)

item.title: UPDATED: How préfectures around France deal with Brexit card renewals
item.description: Roughly 45,000 Brits in France will need to renew their post-Brexit residency cards this year, but exactly how to do this varies depending on where you live. Here's the préfecture-by-préfecture breakdown of the process.

item.title: French word of the day: Clébard
item.description: This French slang word has very interesting origins...

item.title: 15 French words that are originally Arabic
item.description: If you're speaking French on a daily basis, chances are that you are actually using several Arabic words - probably without even knowing it.

item.title: What you pay in France for a visit to a hospital emergency department
item.description: If you have an accident or fall ill in France and have to visit the hospital urgences, you may be presented with a bill - here's how much, who is charged and how to pay.

item.title: EU's EES biometric passport checks catch 4,000 over-stayers in first 4 months
item.description: One of the stated aims of the EU's new EES system of biometric passport checks is to catch people who 'over-stay' the 90-day limit, and 4,000 of those have been caught in the first months of its implementation, according to an EU official.

item.title: How to get a British passport for a child born in France
item.description: While French citizenship is not automatic for children born in France, those who are born to British parents are usually entitled to British nationality (and therefore a passport) from birth. Here's how to apply for the passport.

item.title: Why second-homes are at the heart of France's local elections
item.description: Faced with a housing shortage and an increase in the number of second homes, local elected officials in many areas of France are making the issue of housing a key topic in their campaigns.

item.title: What happens if you overstay your 90-day limit in France?
item.description: If you're visiting France from a non-EU country your time here is limited, unless you have a visa - but what happens to people who overstay and how strictly are the rules enforced?

item.title: How much money do I need for French citizenship?
item.description: Becoming French requires you to be 'sufficiently economically integrated' - but what does this mean in cash terms? Will you be penalised for being on minimum wage or accepting social benefits? And how much does it cost to become French?

item.title: France hikes prices for French citizenship and residency permits
item.description: The French government has significantly increased the fees applied to applications for residency permits and French citizenship in 2026.
